long_biography.plain_text:
Quality Insulation was the foundation of J. Michael Nixon's career. He founded the Connecticut installer and led it for three decades, building a national subcontracting-products business with partner Joe Jillson. After selling a large share of that company, the partners pursued a shared ambition outside construction. They developed Hawks Ridge Golf Club, an invitation-only course on 550 acres north of Atlanta.

Nixon returned to building-products installation as founder and chief executive of TCI Contracting. Installed Building Products acquired TCI in 2012; the transaction added fourteen operating locations in nine states, with most of the consideration paid in shares. Nixon joined the parent company's board later that year and stayed with the business until his 2018 retirement, closing a construction career built through successive founder-led enterprises.
